defs.def: something that forms a connection between people or groups, such as a feeling of friendship or shared ideas and experiences 纽带；联系；关系；契合

ex.s: For Texas cattleman Pete Bonds, it's increasingly difficult to find workers interested in watching cattle.
ex.t: 对德克萨斯州养牛人 Pete Bonds 来说，找到对看牛感兴趣的工人越来越难了。

ex.s: But Bonds doesn't believe a robot is right for the job.
ex.t: 但邦兹不认为机器人适合这份工作。

ex.s: Why does Pete Bonds still hire cowboys to watch cattle?
ex.t: 为什么皮特·邦兹还雇牛仔看牛？

ex.s: "Just five more minutes outdoors can make a difference," David Bond says.
ex.t: “只要在户外再多五分钟就能带来改变，”大卫·邦德说。

ex.s: How did David Bond advocate his idea?
ex.t: David Bond是如何倡导他的想法的？

ex.s: David Bond: A Role Model for Children
ex.t: 大卫·邦德：孩子们的榜样

ex.s: The beauty of rereading lies in the idea that our bond with the work is based on our present mental register.
ex.t: 是真的，年纪越大，我越觉得时光飞逝。

ex.s: A closer bond developed with the readers.
ex.t: 与读者建立起了更紧密的联系。

ex.s: The aim of this initiative is to encourage cooperation and trade across the historic Silk Road areas, and strengthen the bonds between China and the rest of the world.
ex.t: 这一倡议旨在鼓励历史上丝绸之路沿线地区的合作与贸易，并加强中国与世界其他地区之间的联系。

ex.s: To be caught up in such a crisis creates powerful bonds between people, not only between carers and patients, but also between all those who have come from different parts of the world and joined together in a common cause.
ex.t: 身处这样的危机之中，会在人们之间建立起牢固的情感纽带，不仅是照护者与患者之间，也包括那些来自世界各地、为共同事业走到一起的人们之间。

ex.s: Bonds, who bought his first cattle almost 50 years ago, still has each of his cowboys inspect 300 or 400 cattle daily and look for signs that an animal is getting sick.
ex.t: 邦德在近50年前购买了他的第一头牛，他仍然让每个牛仔每天检查300或400头牛，并寻找动物生病的迹象。

ex.s: A couple of years ago, film-maker David Bond realised that his children, then aged five and three, were attached to screens to the point where he was able to say "chocolate" into his three-year-old son’s ear without getting a response.
ex.t: 影片制作人大卫·邦德(David Bond)在几年前意识到，他的孩子当时五岁三岁，被贴在屏幕上，以至于他可以在三岁的儿子的耳朵里说"巧克力"而没有得到回应。

ex.s: Dunn believes that people who reach out to strangers feel a significantly greater sense of belonging, a bond with others.
ex.t: 邓恩认为，主动与陌生人接触的人会感到明显更强的归属感，一种与他人之间的纽带。

ex.t: 而成功改编的最佳例证或许就是詹姆斯·邦德系列，其大部分改编自伊恩·弗莱明的007小说。

ex.t: 莱西，以及一张打了多处修改符号的普通白色证券纸。

the way in which two things are joined together 连接；结合
the way in which atoms are held together in a chemical compound 键合；键

ex.s: “Wax is a complex mixture, but the basic bond in polyethylene, the carbon-carbon bond, is there as well,” she explains, “The wax worm evolved a method or system to break this bond.”
ex.t: “蜡是一种复杂的混合物，但聚乙烯中的基本键——碳碳键——也在其中，”她解释说，“蜡虫进化出了一种方法来破坏这种键。”

to develop or create a relationship of trust with sb 增强（与某人的）信任关系；建立（与某人的）互信关系

ex.s: I always read ,using different voices ,as though I were acting out the stories with my voice and they loved it !It was a special time to bond with my children and it filled them with the wonderment of books .
ex.t: 我总是用不同的声音朗读，仿佛用声音把故事演出来，他们很喜欢！那是一段与孩子建立亲密关系的特别时光，也让他们充满对书籍的惊奇。

ex.s: Taking it as an object of study, psychologists have published various papers stating that the behaviour of sharing is beneficial to setting up positive emotional bonding.
ex.t: 心理学家以（分享行为）为研究对象，发表了多篇论文，指出分享行为有助于建立积极的情感联结。
